name: envelope

source.prompt: One realistic OPEN business envelope, a wide deep horizontal pocket of heavy light-gray laid paper; flap open and pointing upwards at back, with a dark visible opening along the top of the front pocket. Show the envelope almost straight-on, so a separate letter could vertically enter from above. No letter protruding, no stamp, no writing. Emphasize the crisp fold and seam.

method: Use aligned region mask and original neutral luminance. Model used neutral top-left light. Diffuse = min(1,1.2*luma^0.74), specular shoulder above .80, preserve original alpha and unmasked pixels. Region construction is recorded in palette.ts.
